text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- World Health Organisation sees no traces of chemical poisoning in report on reasons for poisoning of Albanian children in the Tetovo region last autumn. Report indicates the possibility of massive simulation and psychologocal causes connected with stress and anxiety from inter-ethnic tensions and mistrust.
- Ethnic Albanians in Tetovo surprised by WHO report. Director of Tetovo hospital Fehmi Demiri said there are no reasons not to believe WHO report.
- Students from Skopje's Kiril and Metodi university to demonstrate today in front of rectorate demanding parliament to pass a new law on higher education in Macedonia.
- An association of workers from all bankrupt companies in Macedonia to organise warning strike in front of Skopje government building on January 17.
